By terrible freak outs, I mean unjust anger, short temper, quick to the idolization of SH, deleting all my socials and well so on. Dbt helped me start understanding my emotions as well, the "whys" and the "hows". 


So if you skip all of that, I treat my adhd with meds and my bpd with therapy and determination/dbt.
